subject: Storage alliance matrix and trial plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Miller <kate@pinecone.io>, Jinhee Lee <j.lee@weaviate.cloud>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Storage alliance matrix and trial plan

Hi Kate / Jinhee —

Thanks again for the sync last week. We want to run a short, focused pilot to validate hybrid storage fallback (S3 cold lane + vector DB hot lane) against two representative Redwood workloads: a customer-facing semantic search flow and a large retriever-chain ingestion pipeline. Goal is measurable latency/cost delta and a clear set of configs we can productize for Dedicated/Private customers.

Proposed scope (30 days):
- Pilot matrix: Pinecone (managed index + S3 fallback), Weaviate (managed + S3 cold-tier), pgvector on RDS + S3 for cold lane
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency under X ms for 95% queries, end-to-end cost per 1M tokens within target band, no data-residency violations
- Deliverables: trial config snippets, test accounts, a short commercial trial term, and a technical kickoff

Can you share:
1) The minimal config we need to enable S3 fallback for a test index (sample YAML or CLI steps)
2) Any sandbox accounts or trial credit process
3) Commercial terms for a 30-day pilot (we'll need a quick term sheet so procurement can sign)

I've attached a trial-matrix-template.xlsx to capture mapping and measurement plan. CCing Vanessa and Ben to track GTM and commercial alignment.

Proposed dates for kickoff: Sept 24-26 (30–60 minute technical call + access handoff).

Thanks,
Diego
Principal Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: trial-matrix-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kate Miller <kate@pinecone.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Green <sam.green@pinecone.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storage alliance matrix and trial plan

Diego —

Appreciate the clear scope. Pinecone is on board for a 30-day technical trial. High level: we can enable S3 cold-tier fallthrough using our vector-store configuration plus a small proxy for redirecting cold reads. I've attached a sample pinecone-trial-config.yaml.

Notes:
- We can provide a sandbox project and $5k trial credits for index operations (Sam in cc will handle account creation).
- For the test index we recommend key settings: upsert chunk size 512, metadata TTL=90d (configurable), fallback policy=prefix-match-first then S3-get
- We'll want a brief security questionnaire answered before we enable service tokens (standard scoping questions only)

Sam will reach out with the trial account and next steps; happy to join the kickoff Sept 25.

Best,
Kate
Partner Solutions Engineer, Pinecone
Attachment: pinecone-trial-config.yaml (text)

I'll also follow up with Weaviate to confirm match on their side (Jinhee — any constraints?).
